attachment_task_tombstones_actor_check.name: attachment_task_tombstones_actor_check
attachment_task_tombstones_actor_check.value: ("attachment_task_tombstones"."purged_at" is null and "attachment_task_tombstones"."purge_actor_type" is null and "attachment_task_tombstones"."purge_actor_id" is null) or ("attachment_task_tombstones"."purged_at" is not null and "attachment_task_tombstones"."purge_actor_type" is not null and "attachment_task_tombstones"."purge_actor_type" in ('user', 'automation', 'git', 'system') and "attachment_task_tombstones"."purge_actor_id" is not null)

intake_attachments_lifecycle_check.name: intake_attachments_lifecycle_check
intake_attachments_lifecycle_check.value:
(
        ("intake_attachments"."status" = 'pending' and "intake_attachments"."staging_object_key" is not null and "intake_attachments"."candidate_key" is null and "intake_attachments"."verified_at" is null and "intake_attachments"."task_key" is null and "intake_attachments"."decided_at" is null)
        or ("intake_attachments"."status" = 'verified' and "intake_attachments"."staging_object_key" is not null and "intake_attachments"."candidate_key" is not null and "intake_attachments"."verified_at" is not null and "intake_attachments"."task_key" is null and "intake_attachments"."decided_at" is null)
        or ("intake_attachments"."status" = 'claimed' and "intake_attachments"."task_key" is not null and "intake_attachments"."decided_at" is not null and "intake_attachments"."staging_object_key" is null and "intake_attachments"."candidate_key" is null and "intake_attachments"."verified_at" is null)
        or ("intake_attachments"."status" = 'released' and "intake_attachments"."task_key" is null and "intake_attachments"."decided_at" is not null and "intake_attachments"."staging_object_key" is null and "intake_attachments"."candidate_key" is null and "intake_attachments"."verified_at" is null)
      )

profile_media_uploads_compaction_idx.name: profile_media_uploads_compaction_idx
profile_media_uploads_compaction_idx.where: "profile_media_uploads"."uploader_user_id" is not null or "profile_media_uploads"."candidate_id" is not null

profile_media_uploads_scope_check.name: profile_media_uploads_scope_check
profile_media_uploads_scope_check.value: ("profile_media_uploads"."owner_kind" = 'avatar' and "profile_media_uploads"."organization_id" is null) or ("profile_media_uploads"."owner_kind" = 'organization-logo' and "profile_media_uploads"."organization_id" is not null and "profile_media_uploads"."organization_id" = "profile_media_uploads"."owner_id")

profile_media_uploads_declaration_check.name: profile_media_uploads_declaration_check
profile_media_uploads_declaration_check.value: num_nonnulls("profile_media_uploads"."uploader_user_id","profile_media_uploads"."content_type","profile_media_uploads"."size_bytes","profile_media_uploads"."expires_at") in (0,4) and ("profile_media_uploads"."status" = 'retired' or "profile_media_uploads"."uploader_user_id" is not null)

profile_media_uploads_derivative_check.name: profile_media_uploads_derivative_check
profile_media_uploads_derivative_check.value: num_nonnulls("profile_media_uploads"."candidate_id","profile_media_uploads"."width","profile_media_uploads"."height","profile_media_uploads"."derivative_size_bytes") in (0,4) and ("profile_media_uploads"."status" not in ('prepared','attached') or "profile_media_uploads"."candidate_id" is not null) and ("profile_media_uploads"."status" <> 'pending' or "profile_media_uploads"."candidate_id" is null)
